label: Like a Flower in Bloom: B

speakers.officer: The United Forces of Humanity Officer

lines.text: A few hours prior.
*Tick tock* *Tick tock*
Rose saunters toward the Commander's Room,
recalling the conversation she had with him only moments ago.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Well? You're the one who asked me to stay behind, so out with it.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Erm...

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: If you feel uncomfortable, you don't have to say it.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: How...

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: How much time do you think you all have left?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: H-how many of you do you expect to come back from this mission?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: And here I thought you had no interest in us.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Yet here you are, asking me such a question.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Quit kidding around and give me a straight answer.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: How many of you do you think are realistically going to come back alive from this?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Like I already told you, the situation could hardly get any worse.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: There are only six of us left, and half of us are at the end of our tether.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: On top of that, this mission is infinitely more difficult compared to those we've done before.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: ... You're right.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Having said that, we're not just going to roll over and die.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: We will do whatever it takes to survive.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You think all of you can make it?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: I can't guarantee anything, but if we put our minds to it, we can...

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: All of you, huh?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Lieutenant?
*Crash*

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: All of you?!

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Lieutenant, are you all right?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: All of you... I knew you would say that.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Let me tell you something. In the end, only one of you will survive. Yet here you are, bloviating about how you'll "do your best".

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Only one?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Only one of us is going to make it?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Is it me?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: You just said we'll all die, didn't you?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Don't tell me that's why we aren't receiving the supplies.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Lieutenant!

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Okay okay, yes! Yes, dammit! Everyone's gonna die!

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: That's why we've been left hanging high and dry, got it?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: It doesn't matter how much you succeed in your assignments,

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: they refuse to lend us any further support until just one of you is left.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: But why?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Is it because we're mass-produced models?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Don't make me laugh.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: If anything, it would have been preferable if you were ordinary mass-produced Nikkes.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: But you're not. You're melee Nikkes.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You're all merely prototypes, but you tried to be like the others, and that's why it's come to this.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: But... we achieved results.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: You said if we kept it up, we could become an officially sanctioned squad...

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Results, yes. Good results? Not so much.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You all sustain damage every single time you go into battle.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: And lest we forget the inordinately high rate of Mind Switch amongst you all? You yourself said that your mental state deteriorates faster because you're seeing the Raptures up close.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: How could a unit that requires so much hands-on maintenance possibly be mass-produced?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: They'd much rather invest in producing a new type of unit altogether.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Because we require more maintenance...? A special unit...?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: You're waiting until there's just one of us left, and then turn us into a Grimms model?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Whoever remains will be converted into a Grimms model. That's why we only need one of you.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: So that's why the missions have been getting harder.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: It's to filter out the weak and select the strongest among us.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You catch on quickly.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: We're not doing this mission.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: I said we won't do it.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: I refuse to go along with this insane plan of yours.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: What the hell is this? What do you think you're doing?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: We have a right to refuse.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: The hell you do!

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: A mass-produced Nikke turning down a standing order?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: They'll think you all suffered a Mind Switch.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: If you all want to be sent to the scrap heap, then be my guest. Refuse the mission.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: It won't matter in the end.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: We've accrued enough data to be able to choose the strongest among you.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: We can still pare it down to just one candidate.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Don't try and get smart with me.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You're the strongest of everyone here, so you'll be the one who survives.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Just follow your orders and you'll make it out of this alive.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Why are you trying to save everyone?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Is it because of your sister?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: In times like this, family doesn't mean squat.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You're Nikkes. You no longer share the same blood, and yet you insist on calling her your sister?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: It's a jungle out there, and everyone is in competition.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Enough of this.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: What did I ever do to deserve this?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: I was told that if I became your commander, I'd be set for life. I could live peacefully, they said.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: So why, WHY do you continue to drag me out here and make me live on a battlefield?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You listen, and listen good.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: If you want to survive, everyone else has to die.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: This is what your squad was created for in the first place. This is the way things have to end.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: So stop saying that everyone will live.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: This is the only way I can get out of this hellhole!

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Don't you want to be done with this place too?

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You want supplies.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: You want to eat good food and rest.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Well then, let's get this over with and go back.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: It'll be good for us both.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Not just us, in fact.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: If they're destined to die anyway, you could give them a painless death. End their suffering.
Disparate thoughts swirl through Rose's mind.
Would the sole survivor really live on?
The company never intended for their squad to last from the very beginning.
Even if there was one lone survivor,
what would prevent them from turning them into lab rat, sucking out their essence and planting it in other bodies?
There was no way to completely restore a body and mind damaged by countless battles.
The higher-ups almost certainly wanted to extrapolate their proficiencies and experiences and transfer them to a more proper subject.
In the end, even the lone survivor would be rendered asunder, eradicated, and left as a mere compilation of 1's and 0's.
The more their squad succeeded,
the more they played into the enemy's hand.
They were meant to suffer, until they expired.
That was the fate which had been accorded to them.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: ... Yes. Right.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Nothing lasts forever.
Rose continued to ruminate.
If their succeeding would lead to their downfall, then failure was naturally the only viable path to survival.
If she wanted to defy the expectations that had been placed upon them,
then she had to aim for failure in its most absolute form.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: I'm glad you're coming around.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: At least you and I are going to make it out of here!
Rose's mind continues to swirl with a panoply of thoughts.
Then, she makes a decision.
She knows what to protect,
and what to discard.
Rose stands in front of the door.
*Knock knock*

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Lieutenant, it's Rose.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: I have something important I need to discuss with you.
Scarlet sprints through the hallways.
Despite the fact that she is a Nikke, and there is no conceivable way she would be out of breath,
she nevertheless feels strangely winded as she runs.
An oppressive feeling of unease rises in her chest and then presses down, crushing her.
If Rose crossed a line
from which there was no coming back,
what would she do?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_o
lines.text: Please, Rose, don't!
By the time she arrived at the Commander's Room, Rose was standing there, alone.
The walls and the ceiling were torn apart, and stained crimson.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: There you are.
Drenched in human blood.
